about_the_game:
Transform your Chaos Gremlin into the ultimate style icon with the Mother Machine Cosmetics Pack! Packed with funky skins, goofy head attachments, and more, you'll be able to give your creature the look it deserves. Whether you're going for cute, weird, or super gross, the possibilities are endless with 50+ brand-new options!

What’s included:

New Head Attachments

Unlock new head attachments that add fun and personality to your Gremlin. From whimsical to wild, these accessories are perfect for expressing your Gremlin’s unique style!

New Eyes

Express your Gremlin’s personality with catchy new eye types that are both cute and weird. Each eye style offers something new to match your Gremlin’s attitude, whether it's playful, mischievous, or anything in between!

New Ears

Get yourself some adorable new ear types to make your Gremlin even cuter (or weirder). From floppy to perky, these ears are perfect for any style of gremlin chaos.

New Limb Attachments

Add some flair to your Gremlin’s limbs with limb attachments. These fun and unique additions will give your Gremlin’s limbs a completely new look, perfect for customizing and expressing your chaotic personality!

New Back Attachments

Make your Gremlin stand out with these new back attachments! From wiggly to spiky, these accessories will give your Gremlin an extra dose of flair. Perfect for adding even more chaos to your look!

New Skins

Get ready for some psychedelic new skin patterns and funky skin colors! Your Gremlin will be glowing in vibrant, swirling hues that are sure to turn heads in the caves.

short_description: Unleash your creativity with our new Cosmetics Pack! (Base game required.) Customize your Gremlin with 50+ skins, body parts & attachments. Craft the most outrageously chaotic creation for Mother's expeditions and express a look as wild and unique as your playstyle!
